blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuano boxers John Paul Gabunilas and Justine Trazo of the Chao Sy Boxing Stable suffered contrasting but equally frustrating defeats against their Japanese opponents, with both Filipino fighters losing by unanimous decision (UD) in their respective bouts at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, on Saturday, November 7. Despite putting up competitive performances, Gabunilas and Trazo failed to convince the judges, with the results raising questions about the scoring of their closely contested fights. Gabunilas absorbed a unanimous decision loss to Shori Umezo, with all three judges scoring the eight-round bout in favor of the Japanese fighter, 78-73, […]...
